title: Karyo model
description: A language-neutral description of how a codebase fits together: declared, extracted and observed nodes, edges and traced flows. Fragments from several producers merge by node id.

groups.description: Named groups (a node names its own in group): labels and nesting, from a curation file (docs/MODEL.md, Curation)

start.description: What a structure board starts on, from a curation file: one card per group, or every card (docs/ENGINE.md, Group navigation)

coverage.description: Recordings that watched every call inside some scopes (docs/MODEL.md, Coverage): what lets nodes and relationships say they were not exercised

tours.description: Authored tours resolved at build time against the code and the recorded flows (docs/MODEL.md, Tours)

source.description: proposed: only a splice says so (docs/MODEL.md, Splices); never written by a producer

kind.description: service, function, type (a class, struct, record or interface), store, queue, external, actor, module, or a kit's node kind (docs/KITS.md): any other lowercase word, drawn with the kit's card (the default card when no kit adds it)

fields.description: A kit kind's own data (docs/KITS.md), checked against the kind's fields schema; its card and details sections read it

parent.description: The node this one is part of (a method's type, a step's process)

fold.description: Views draw it folded into its parent: its relationships and recorded calls roll up onto the parent (docs/MODEL.md, Fold). Automatic mode folds methods; a curation file changes it

exercised.description: Set only when a recording watched this node's code in full (a coverage scope): whether it ran. false: not exercised by the recorded runs. Equals whether sources has observed

category.description: One declared word (e.g. tool, store, stage) views can color or filter by. Merge keeps the richest declaration's; a different one is a category-conflict warning

tags.description: Declared free-form labels (e.g. hot-path). Merge takes the union

code.description: A declaration's source, captured from the code (decorators or doc comment included): lines start..end of file, verbatim, at most 80 lines

truncated.description: The declaration is longer than 80 lines; end is the last line kept

kind.description: The relationship's kind; with several (kinds), the first of them

kinds.description: Every kind the pair carries, in canonical order (calls, reads, writes, publishes, subscribes), when there are several. A merged model has at most one non-import edge per ordered pair (docs/MODEL.md, Identity); a model that repeats a pair is read as one edge

count.description: Recorded calls attributed to this relationship

exercised.description: Relationships only, set when a recording watched both ends in full: whether the call was seen. false: not exercised by the recorded runs

flow.description: Flow name, set on the span that started the flow
The recorded flow the steps take their timings from

group.description: Consecutive steps sharing a group are drawn as one bracketed group

ms.description: Sum of the matched spans' durations

parent.description: The group this one sits in

scope.description: Module, package or node id prefixes (dotted) whose every call the recording watched

sample.description: Only this share of flows was recorded

level.description: error: an identity conflict or a broken engine invariant (builds and checks fail); warn: code and docs disagree; info: worth knowing
